About
The Training and Placement Office (TPO) bridges the gap between academia and industry by preparing students for job placements and facilitating their recruitment.
It supports students in acquiring skills, securing internships, and finding employment through collaboration with top companies and institutions.

Overview
Industry Interaction
➡️ Collaborates with industries for campus recruitment.
➡️ Establishes Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with companies.
➡️ Arranges industrial visits and internships.
Student Training
➡️ Organizes pre-placement training programs.
➡️ Offers soft skills, aptitude, technical, and communication skills workshops.
➡️ Conducts resume-building and interview-preparation sessions.
Campus Recruitment
➡️ Coordinates with recruiters for on-campus/off-campus drives.
➡️ Schedules interviews, tests, and group discussions.
➡️ Provides logistical support during recruitment.
Career Guidance
➡️ Helps students choose career paths: jobs, higher education, or entrepreneurship.
➡️ Arranges expert lectures, alumni talks, and career counseling sessions.
Internship Support
➡️ Facilitates summer/winter internships with reputed companies.
➡️ Ensures students gain practical exposure and fulfill curriculum requirements.
